description: Checkmyguest offers you this modern 65m2 apartment for up to 10 people. Decorated with care and equipped with all modern conveniences, you'll have everything you need for an excellent stay! Located in the dynamic 13th arrondissement of Paris, this neighborhood is a hidden gem, offering a unique blend of historic charm and contemporary living. A parking space is included.The spaceDiscover a collection of characterful houses and apartments that combine ideal locations with high-end amenities, all while being family-friendly. With us, you are simply at home! Let yourself be seduced by the design and furniture created by our team.Our exceptional apartment, which can accommodate up to 10 people, offers you a comfortable travel experience with quality furniture. The space is perfectly optimized, creating a warm, friendly, and harmonious atmosphere. The decor is refined, where the harmony of tones meets beautiful materials, and its two lovely bedrooms, including one master suite, will be a true haven of peace.Enjoy the cultural richness, exceptional gastronomy, and vibrant atmosphere of this must-visit area. Experience a dynamic and welcoming community right outside your door. When it comes to dining, the options are endless.With several metro stations nearby, it will be an ideal starting point to explore all corners of Paris: the Eiffel Tower, the Champs-Élysées, Montmartre and the Basilica of the Sacred Heart, the Louvre Museum, the Île de la Cité and Notre-Dame de Paris, and the Left Bank.For added peace of mind, a local police station is conveniently located just a short walk from the apartment.Our ground floor apartment includes:- A modern living room with: 2 double sofa beds, a side table, a beautiful dining table, and a television.- An open kitchen adjacent to the livin
